cards.title: git clone
cards.body: `git clone <url>` downloads a whole repository from GitHub into a new folder named after it, with `origin` already set up.

hi.title: git clone
hi.body: `git clone <url>` GitHub se poori repository ek naye folder mein download karta hai jiska naam repository jaisa hota hai, `origin` pehle se set ke saath.

cards.title: Then go inside
cards.body: The clone is a folder like any other: `cd` into it to start working.

hi.title: Phir andar jao
hi.body: Clone bhi kisi aur folder jaisa hi hai: kaam shuru karne ke liye `cd` se uske andar jao.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: `cd` fails right after the clone. Which line is wrong?
cards.code:
git clone https://github.com/loophole/recipes.git
cd recipes.git
git log --oneline

bug.fix: The new folder is named after the repository, without `.git`: `cd recipes`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Clone ke turant baad `cd` fail hota hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: Naye folder ka naam repository ke naam par hota hai, bina `.git` ke: `cd recipes`.

check.question: You run `git clone https://github.com/ada/notes.git`. Which folder appears?
check.explanation: The folder takes the repository's name, without `.git`.

hi.question: Aap `git clone https://github.com/ada/notes.git` chalate ho. Kaunsa folder banta hai?
hi.explanation: Folder ko repository ka naam milta hai, bina `.git` ke.

exercise.prompt: Clone `https://github.com/loophole/demo.git`, then go into its folder.
exercise.promptHi: `https://github.com/loophole/demo.git` ko clone karo, phir uske folder mein jao.
